lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Boca Raton, Florida. Home of the Florida Atlantic Owls. In 2011 the school opened a new football stadium. It borrowed more than forty-five million dollars to build it. And it needed somebody to put a name on it.
lines.caption: Boca Raton, Florida. Home of the Florida Atlantic Owls. In 2011 the school opened a new football stadium. It borrowed more than forty-five million dollars to build it. And it needed somebody to put a name on it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: February 19, 2013. The trustees vote, and it is unanimous. Six million dollars over twelve years, the largest gift in school history. And the name on the building will be GEO Group Stadium.
lines.caption: February 19, 2013. The trustees vote, and it is unanimous. Six million dollars over twelve years, the largest gift in school history. And the name on the building will be GEO Group Stadium.
lines.visual: card:$6,000,000|Twelve years · GEO Group Stadium · February 19, 2013

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: I am down here for the winter and I will say it. A donation is a donation. Every stadium in America has a bank or a pizza chain on it.
lines.caption: I am down here for the winter and I will say it. A donation is a donation. Every stadium in America has a bank or a pizza chain on it.

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: Gary, this one is not a pizza chain. GEO Group runs private prisons. Its headquarters is right here in Boca Raton.
lines.caption: Gary, this one is not a pizza chain. GEO Group runs private prisons. Its headquarters is right here in Boca Raton.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The man who ran the company, George Zoley, had two degrees from FAU. He had once chaired the same board that took the money.
lines.caption: The man who ran the company, George Zoley, had two degrees from FAU. He had once chaired the same board that took the money.
lines.visual: card:George Zoley|GEO Group chief executive · two FAU degrees · former chair of the FAU trustees

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Here is the part that was not in the press release. A federal judge in Mississippi had called one of the company's youth prisons a cesspool. Texas had shut down one of its youth centers over filthy conditions. And ten miles from campus, it ran a detention center for immigrants.
lines.caption: Here is the part that was not in the press release. A federal judge in Mississippi had called one of the company's youth prisons a cesspool. Texas had shut down one of its youth centers over filthy conditions. And ten miles from campus, it ran a detention center for immigrants.
lines.visual: card:“A cesspool of unconstitutional and inhuman acts”|U.S. District Judge Carlton Reeves · Walnut Grove, Mississippi · March 26, 2012

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: The day after the vote, somebody deleted the controversies section from the company's Wikipedia page. The account carried the name of a GEO spokesman.
lines.caption: The day after the vote, somebody deleted the controversies section from the company's Wikipedia page. The account carried the name of a GEO spokesman.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: That is not a great look.
lines.caption: That is not a great look.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The students noticed. These were not football boosters. They were commuters and working students, and a lot of them were the children of immigrants. Within a day they had a name for the place. Owlcatraz.
lines.caption: The students noticed. These were not football boosters. They were commuters and working students, and a lot of them were the children of immigrants. Within a day they had a name for the place. Owlcatraz.
lines.visual: card:Owlcatraz|The students' name for it

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: Two days after the vote it was on the Colbert Report. Four days after that, more than thirty students were sitting in the president's office.
lines.caption: Two days after the vote it was on the Colbert Report. Four days after that, more than thirty students were sitting in the president's office.
lines.visual: card:February 25, 2013|More than thirty students sit in at the president's office

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The president told a room of two hundred and fifty people that it was a done deal.
lines.caption: The president told a room of two hundred and fifty people that it was a done deal.
lines.visual: card:“A done deal”|The FAU president, to a room of 250

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: The Faculty Senate voted on it March 22. Twenty-five to nine against the name.
lines.caption: The Faculty Senate voted on it March 22. Twenty-five to nine against the name.
lines.visual: card:25 to 9|Faculty Senate, against the name · March 22, 2013

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Then, on March 22, protesters surrounded the president's car. She drove off. And one of the protesters said the side mirror clipped them on the way out.
lines.caption: Then, on March 22, protesters surrounded the president's car. She drove off. And one of the protesters said the side mirror clipped them on the way out.

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: She hit a student?
lines.caption: She hit a student?

lines.speaker: S
lines.say: Allegedly clipped. The student said that by the book it was a hit and run. Nobody was charged.
lines.caption: Allegedly clipped. The student said that by the book it was a hit and run. Nobody was charged.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: Ten days later, on April first, the prison company pulled out. Its chief executive said the gift had surprisingly evolved into an ongoing distraction.
lines.caption: Ten days later, on April first, the prison company pulled out. Its chief executive said the gift had surprisingly evolved into an ongoing distraction.
lines.visual: card:“An ongoing distraction”|George Zoley, withdrawing the gift · April 1, 2013

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The president said, we'd like always to have good donors and keep our money. Six weeks later she resigned.
lines.caption: The president said, we'd like always to have good donors and keep our money. Six weeks later she resigned.
lines.visual: card:“We'd like always to have good donors and keep our money.”|The FAU president · she resigned in May 2013

lines.speaker: R
lines.say: All right. A donation is not just a donation. I take it back.
lines.caption: All right. A donation is not just a donation. I take it back.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: The kids won. No lawyers. No money. Six weeks and a nickname, and they sent a three billion dollar company home.
lines.caption: The kids won. No lawyers. No money. Six weeks and a nickname, and they sent a three billion dollar company home.
lines.visual: card:Six weeks|February 19 to April 1, 2013

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: But listen to what they were actually saying. Their statement said the school was putting the families of its Hispanic students at risk of being detained. That was the fear in 2013. The detention business was getting too close to campus.
lines.caption: But listen to what they were actually saying. Their statement said the school was putting the families of its Hispanic students at risk of being detained. That was the fear in 2013. The detention business was getting too close to campus.

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: So hold that thought. Because twelve years later, and about fifty miles south, another Florida university got an offer. Not from the prison company this time. From the federal agency that fills its beds.
lines.caption: So hold that thought. Because twelve years later, and about fifty miles south, another Florida university got an offer. Not from the prison company this time. From the federal agency that fills its beds.
lines.visual: card:Twelve years later|About fifty miles south

lines.speaker: M
lines.say: And that university did not hold a vote on a name. It signed.
lines.caption: And that university did not hold a vote on a name. It signed.
lines.visual: card:It signed.|
